title: Network coordinator worker Batch 4 path-map read DTO safety
summary: Batch 4 closes network coordinator/worker path-map and read-DTO findings by preserving order-sensitive manual maps, hardening Windows path-map parsing/application, separating manual/auto/effective path-map drift evidence, and surfacing malformed or stale worker_state.json evidence in Network workers DTOs.
reason: The audit found that overlapping manual path-map prefixes could be reordered, unsafe mapped paths could escape intended worker roots, auto-derived library maps could appear as saved-config drift, malformed worker_state.json rows looked clean, and stale active worker state could be reported as a clean stopped runtime.
behavior_before: Worker join import serialized WorkerSourcePathMap with key sorting, manual/legacy path-map fallback accepted unsafe roots/tails, drift detection compared saved manual maps against effective running maps, malformed worker_state.json only emitted a global warning, and active worker_state.json plus stopped lifecycle memory could show Runtime: Stopped (match).
behavior_after: Worker join import preserves manual map order; path-map parsing rejects relative, drive-relative, and parent-traversal roots; mapped claim tails with parent traversal are released as unstartable; auto maps remain separate from manual drift comparison; malformed worker_state.json state rows are unreadable with bounded redacted errors; stopped lifecycle with active worker_state.json reports stale-claim warning status.
manual_validation: apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe ops/scripts/dev/run-python-tool.py mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage -> passed (317 packet(s) valid; no uncovered dirty files reported)
rollback_plan: Revert the scoped changes in the listed path-map, join import, worker runtime descriptor, network facade DTO, tests, and generated summaries. Then rerun the same targeted pytest commands plus change-control validation.
notes:
